mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 3.0% relative to its 10-year moving average compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days regardless of economic cycle.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 3.0% (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate exceeding 5.5% for two consecutive months signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE > 5.5% (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering equity sell-offs and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict negative 20d returns in more than 30% of cases (i.e., positive returns occur in >30% of such events).

mechanism_narrative: High industrial production growth (INDPRO > 0.5% MoM) signals easing supply constraints and expanding profit margins, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days during expansionary phases.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 55% of instances when INDPRO > 0.5% MoM (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: Accelerating inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY) triggers imminent Federal Reserve tightening, increasing equity discount rates and causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5% YoY (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payrolls growth (PAYEMS > 100k) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when PAYEMS > 100k (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: Sharp industrial production decline (INDPRO < 115.0) relative to 12-month average signals manufacturing contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in less than 45% of instances when INDPRO < 115.0 (based on 2005-01-03 to 2024-12-31 data).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in retail sales (RSAFS) and GDP growth (GDPC1) indicate economic contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through earnings deterioration.
failure_condition: The joint decline in RSAFS and GDPC1 fails to predict negative 20d returns in more than 35% of cases.
